messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: svc-runtime-prod-3 is reporting repeated container crashloops (segfault). 21% error rate on route /v1/generate. Node: gpu-node-17. Auto-remediation tried restart x3, still crashloop. Logs: /var/log/runtime/segfault.log -> see attached. LINK: https://internal.logs/xyz
ben (oncall): acknowledged. jumping in. can someone grab the latest core dump and stack trace? tagging eng-runtime.
alice (eng-runtime): grabbing core now. preliminary gdb shows SIGSEGV in fused_kernels.so +0x1f2a when sequence_length > 2048. stack shows vllm::fused_attention::compute at fused_kernels.cc:482
carla (eng-sre): traffic steering: i'll cut 50% traffic to svc-runtime-prod-3 and shift to svc-runtime-prod-1/2, applying weight override. doing kubectl patch svcconfig --namespace=prod --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/weights/svc-runtime-prod-3","value":0.5}]'
ben (oncall): confirmed weight change propagated. still seeing crashloops on node gpu-node-17 but 500s dropped from 21% -> 9% overall.
dylan (support): customer impact: two enterprise tenants (acme-corp, medai) showing timeouts and error spikes in dashboards. opened INC-2231 to notify accounts. preparing standard customer message.
eve (product): flagging potential SLA breach for medai—we're in a paid plan. prioritize mitigation.
alice (eng-runtime): short-term mitigation idea: restart runtime with env var REDWOOD_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=1 to force non-fused codepath. that should avoid segfault until we patch the kernel.
carla (eng-sre): can we hotpatch without full deploy? we can set env on kube deployment and rollout restart. doing: 
```
kubectl set env deployment/svc-runtime-prod-3 -n prod REDWOOD_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=1
kubectl rollout restart deployment/svc-runtime-prod-3 -n prod
``` 
will monitor.
ben (oncall): do it. be careful with memory — non-fused path will increase RAM by ~25% per worker. ensure nodes have headroom.
alice (eng-runtime): noted. also submitting core dump + symbols to CI for repro. attaching small reproducer to try to hit the codepath locally.
carla (eng-sre): env set, rollout started. current pods terminating -> creating new pods with env var. watch logs: `kubectl logs -f deployment/svc-runtime-prod-3 -n prod`.
ben (oncall): incident-bot: mark incident P1? we have customer impact and partial mitigation ongoing.
incident-bot: Incident SEV: P1 (customer-impact). Pager escalation: Level 2 required.
dylan (support): customer notification draft: "We're aware of increased errors on the inference API; we've routed traffic and applied a mitigation. No data loss; working on fix. ETA for full resolution: 2-4 hours." Sending to accounts now.
eve (product): approve message. include contact for urgent escalations.
alice (eng-runtime): new pods with REDWOOD_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL are coming up. early logs show no segfaults so far, but memory usage is up ~22% on those pods.
carla (eng-sre): memory bumped but fits. crashloop rate dropped to near 0 on node gpu-node-17 for these pods. overall error rate down to 2.7%.
ben (oncall): good. can we cordon and drain gpu-node-17 and repro on a staging node with same GPU driver to validate root cause? avoid surprising other tenants.
alice (eng-runtime): yes. will repro on staging-gpu-09 with a long-seq workload. initial hypothesis: null deref when sequence_length state crosses page boundary in fused attention optimizer. need to run ASAN build to confirm.
carla (eng-sre): cordoning gpu-node-17 now: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-17` then `kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`.
ben (oncall): draining started. moving any remaining mission-critical pods to other nodes.
dylan (support): looping in account managers for medai and acme-corp with mitigation update. they asked for daily postmortem.
eve (product): track this under INF-2571. please include perf impact numbers and suggested long-term mitigations (kernel patch, fallback policy by seq length).
alice (eng-runtime): repro on staging succeeded with ASAN: detected invalid read in fused_kernels.cc:482. root cause: race when KV cache resizing hits an uninitialized pointer. fix will be a bounds check + init of fallback buffer. patch in progress.
carla (eng-sre): good. are we ready to re-enable fused kernel on prod after patch? we should do a canary and gradual rollout.
alice (eng-runtime): patch submitted to repo and CI green on unit tests. plan: deploy canary to svc-runtime-prod-2 with REDWOOD_ENABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=1 and an additional guard env REDWOOD_FUSED_KERNEL_SAFE_CHECK=1 which enables extra bounds checks for 24h. k8s steps:
```
kubectl set env deployment/svc-runtime-prod-2 -n prod REDWOOD_ENABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=1 REDWOOD_FUSED_KERNEL_SAFE_CHECK=1
kubectl rollout status deployment/svc-runtime-prod-2 -n prod
``` 
then monitor.
ben (oncall): do canary. i'll stay on until handoff at 15:00 UTC. carla, can you take second-oncall after handoff?
carla (eng-sre): yes, i'll take it.
dylan (support): customers ack'd message, appreciate speed. they asked for ETA on full rollback vs permanent fix.
ealice (eng-runtime): full fix target: next hotfix release in 8 hours, followed by production rollout over next 6 hours. if canary stable, we re-enable fused kernel gradually.
carla (eng-sre): canary healthy after 40m, no segfaults, latency within 5% of baseline.
ben (oncall): handing off to carla for next shift. summary: P1, crashloops due to segfault in fused_kernels; temp mitigation: disable fused kernels in prod (REDWOOD_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=1). canary patch for safe fused kernel checks deployed to prod-2. customers notified. tracking ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2571. handoff issued at 15:02 UTC.
carla (eng-sre): ack received. I'll continue monitoring and prepare postmortem doc. assigning follow-ups: 
- ENG-RT: fix kernel and add unit coverage (alice)
- SRE: playbook update for fused kernel incidents (carla)
- Support: customer follow-ups and timeline (dylan)
closing-note-bot: Incident moved to "stabilizing". Please update statusboard and add timeline notes.
ben (oncall): thanks team. great coordination. moving to standby.
carla (eng-sre): thanks all — will open postmortem and link to INF-2571 once draft complete.
